prova:
intro ε hε
  apply Filter.eventually_of_forall
  intro N hN
  refine le_trans ?_ ?_
  -- f r N ≤ N
  apply (Nat.sSup_le (by intro k hk; rcases hk with ⟨A, hA, hA', hkA⟩; exact_mod_cast
    (Finset.card_le_card hA))).mpr
  simpa [Nat.sSup_le] using le_trans (Nat.sSup_le (by intro k hk; rcases hk with ⟨A, hA, hA', hkA⟩; exact_mod_cast hA.1))
    (show (N : ℕ) ∈ {k : ℕ | ∃ A : Finset ℕ, A ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 N ∧
      (∀ S ⊆ A, S.card = r → ¬ (∃ d, (S : Set ℕ).Pairwise fun a b => Nat.gcd a b = d)) ∧ A.card = k} from
      ⟨Finset.Icc 1 N, le_rfl, by intro S hS hS'; push Not at hS'; rcases hS' with ⟨d, hd, hhd⟩;
        by_cases hN : N = 0 <;> push Nat at hN <;> contradiction, (Finset.Icc 1 N).card⟩)
  -- N ≤ N^{3/4 + ε} for sufficiently large N
  have hN2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) := by
    refine Nat.le_of_lt ?_
    by_contra hN3
    have : (N : ℕ) < 2 := by omega
    have hN4 : N ≤ 1 := by omega
    have hN5 : ¬ (2 < N) := by omega
    contradiction
  have hpow_pos : 0 < (N : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hexp_pos : 0 < (3 : ℝ) / 4 + ε := by positivity
  have hexp_ge : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (3 : ℝ) / 4 + ε := by
    have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (3 : ℝ) / 4 + ε := by
      have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (3 : ℝ) / 4 := by norm_num
      have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (3 : ℝ) / 4 + ε := by
        nlinarith [Real.log_pos (by positivity : (1 : ℝ) < 2)]
      exact this
    exact this
  have hlog_pos : 0 < Real.log (N : ℝ) := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
  have hN_pow_pos : 0 < (N : ℝ) ^ ((3 : ℝ) / 4 + ε) := by positivity
  have hN_pow_ge_one : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ ((3 : ℝ) / 4 + ε) :=
    Real.one_le_rpow (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hN_pow_le : (N : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ ((3 : ℝ) / 4 + ε) := by
    have hlogN : 0 < Real.log (N : ℝ) := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
    have hlogN2 : 0 < 2 * Real.log (N : ℝ) := by positivity
    have hlogN3 : 0 < 3 * Real.log (N : ℝ) := by positivity
    have hN_ge_4 : (4 : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) := by
      by_contra hN4
      have : (N : ℕ) < 4 := by omega
      have hN5 : N ≤ 3 := by omega
      have hN6 : ¬ (4 < N) := by omega
      contradiction
    have hlogN_ge : Real.log 4 ≤ Real.log (N : ℝ) := Real.log_le_log (by positivity) hN_ge_4
    have hlog4 : Real.log 4 = 2 * Real.log 2 := by
      rw [← Real.log_pow] <;> norm_num
    have hlog2_pos : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
    have hlog4_pos : 0 < Real.log 4 := by positivity
    have hlog4_gt_1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log 4 := by
      have : Real.log 4 ≥ 1 := by
        have h : Real.log 4 = 2 * Real.log 2 := by
          rw [← Real.log_pow] <;> norm_num
        have h2 : Real.log 2 ≥ 1 / 2 := by
          have : Real.log 2 ≥ 1 / 2 := by
            have h3 : (2 : ℝ) ≥ Real.exp (1 / 2) := by
              have : Real.exp (1 / 2) < 2 := by
                have : Real.exp (1 / 2) ≤ Real.exp 1 := by
                  apply Real.exp_le_exp
                  nlinarith [Real.log_exp_one_pos]
                have : Real.exp 1 < 2 := by
                  exact Real.exp_lt_exp_one_sub (by norm_num)
                linarith
              linarith
            have : Real.log (Real.exp (1 / 2)) ≤ Real.log 2 := Real.log_le_log (by positivity) h
            have : Real.log (Real.exp (1 / 2)) = 1 / 2 := by rw [Real.log_exp]
            linarith
          exact this
        have : Real.log 4 = 2 * Real.log 2 := by
          rw [← Real.log_pow] <;> norm_num
        nlinarith
      exact this
    have hgoal : 1 ≤ (3 : ℝ) / 4 + ε := by
      linarith
    have hkey : (1 : ℝ) * Real.log (N : ℝ) ≤ ((3 : ℝ) / 4 + ε) * Real.log (N : ℝ) := by
      nlinarith [hgoal]
    have hkey2 : Real.log (N : ℝ) ≤ Real.log ((N : ℝ) ^ ((3 : ℝ) / 4 + ε)) := by
      have : Real.log ((N : ℝ) ^ ((3 : ℝ) / 4 + ε)) = ((3 : ℝ) / 4 + ε) * Real.log (N : ℝ) := by
        rw [Real.log_rpow hN_pos]
      rw [this]
      nlinarith
    have hfinal : (N : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ ((3 : ℝ) / 4 + ε) := by
      apply Real.log_le_log (by positivity)
      nlinarith
    exact hfinal
  exact hN_pow_le
